items.body: The replacement loader control runs `#!/bin/bash` fixtures while requiring `DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=loader-marker`. On macOS with SIP enabled, protected system binaries purge dyld environment variables. The fake mise, previous wrapper, and compiler probe therefore discard the marker, causing guest success-path tests to fail regardless of whether the native launcher preserves it. [Apple’s runtime protection documentation](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/Security/Conceptual/System_Integrity_Protection_Guide/RuntimeProtections/RuntimeProtections.html) confirms this behavior.
items.suggestion: Inject the marker immediately before launching the native wrapper and observe it through native compiler and previous-wrapper fixtures. Keep shell orchestration checks separate from the loader inheritance assertion.
